name: com.changerella/app
title: Changerella — crypto swap aggregator
description: Compare live quotes from instant crypto exchangers, with KYC ratings, and get a ready swap link.

tools.name: search_assets
tools.description: Search the coins and networks that can be exchanged (by ticker or name, e.g. "usdt", "monero"). Returns code + network pairs to use in the other tools, whether the coin can be sent and/or received, and its USD price. Cheap: served from memory.

query.description: Ticker or coin name; empty lists the biggest coins.

side.description: Only coins that can be sent (from) or received (to).

tools.name: get_quotes
tools.description: Live offers from all exchangers serving the pair for the given amount, best first: amount received after all fees, rate, KYC rating (A best … D), ETA, limits, and a swap_url per offer for the user to complete the exchange. Rate-limited (answers are cached for a minute); do not poll.

from_network.description: Network of the sent coin, e.g. TRX for USDT on Tron. Required when the coin lives on several networks.

max_kyc.description: Only exchangers with this KYC rating or better (A = no KYC expected).

tools.name: get_market_rates
tools.description: Best current rate per popular direction (e.g. BTC→USDT, USDT→XMR) from a periodically refreshed snapshot. Cheap, no live request; filter by from/to ticker.

tools.name: get_swap_link
tools.description: A link that opens the Changerella calculator on the pair (and amount), where the user compares offers and completes the swap themselves. Validates that the pair can be exchanged. Cheap: no live request.

tools.name: list_exchangers
tools.description: The exchangers Changerella compares, with their KYC rating (A — no KYC expected … D — KYC likely).

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Status of an exchange the user created on Changerella, by the order id from its page address (app.changerella.com/order/<id>): stage, amounts, payout transaction id. Addresses are not returned.

order_id.description: UUID from the order page URL.
